correctness.rationale: A face uses at most four arcs; every external W is supported on at most four columns. The exact finite certificate covers all 312 W orbit forms, checks the entire directed Hasse graph for each and the base, and proves that all nonbase critical cells are dimension three. Poset patchwork gives a global acyclic matching. One critical point plus only 3-cells gives an integral wedge; direct face enumerators determine the quartic count. Exact mod-two low parameter computations prove sharp threshold.
